description.text:
One row is: An ADT event record with its effective time, patient, patient class, department, room, bed, patient service, service area, and related record IDs.

Who's in it: Patients with Census event records during the reporting period, for the chosen service area and the chosen location. Choosing All for the chosen service area or the chosen location includes all.

Each row shows: event details, when it took effect, patient identifiers and class, location, and service information

Time window: The report includes census events from the chosen start date through the chosen end date, with the end date counted in full. It shows the data as it stood at the end of the chosen as-of date: only events entered by then are included, and a canceled census event is still included if it was not deleted until after that day.

Excludes: Exclude records not linked to a patient, and records from CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR.

terms.bt_name: Census ADT events in included inpatient units as of a chosen date
terms.business_description:
Definition: Census ADT events for patients in included units, shown as the data stood on the chosen as of date and limited to events that took effect during the chosen start and end dates.
One row is: One census ADT event for one patient at the time it took effect, with its patient class, department, room, bed, patient service, service area, and census day.
Keeps: Events that took effect from the chosen start date through the chosen end date, were created before the day after the chosen as of date, are in the chosen service area and chosen location through the two required linked selections, and are included as of the chosen as of date whether they were still active then or were canceled later.
Excludes: Events without a recorded patient, events from CCMC EMERGENCY, CCMC IR IMAGING, CCMC CATH LAB, CCMC MAIN OR, CCMC SPA OR, CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY, CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR, and DSC OR, and canceled events that were already deleted before the day after the chosen as of date.
terms.technical_definition:
Population:
- The event record category is 'Census' (6).
- The instant when the event was supposed to have happened is on or after @StartDate.
- The instant when the event was supposed to have happened is before DATEADD(D, 1, @EndDate).
- The instant when the event record was actually created is before DATEADD(D, 1, @AsOfDate).
- A matching record exists in a separately defined selection.
- A matching record exists in a separately defined selection.
- The category value indicating whether the event record has been changed or deleted is not 'Canceled' (2).
- The category value indicating whether the event record has been changed or deleted is 'Canceled' (2).
- The instant when the event record was actually deleted is on or after DATEADD(D, 1, @AsOfDate).

Exclusions:
- The pat id is recorded.
- The unit of the event record at the effective time ID is none of the values 'CCMC EMERGENCY' (100108022), 'CCMC IR IMAGING' (100108034), 'CCMC CATH LAB' (100108047), 'CCMC MAIN OR' (100108049), 'CCMC SPA OR' (100108068), 'CCMC PHP PSYCHIATRY' (100108112), 'CCMC CARDIOVASCULAR OR' (100108118), 'DSC OR' (100639001).

Parameters:
- the as of date (no default)
- the end date (no default)
- the location (no default)
- the service area (no default)
- the start date (no default)
